headline: Frequent Reworks in Style Class Functionality
diagnosis: The commit history shows a pattern of frequent fixes and reworks related to the `Style` class and its attributes. Specifically, changes to function names, type fixes, and cache management indicate ongoing issues with the implementation and understanding of the class's functionality.
plan: Conduct a thorough review of the `Style` class to identify inconsistencies in attribute handling and method definitions.
Implement a comprehensive set of unit tests targeting the `Style` class to ensure all attributes and methods behave as expected.
Refactor the caching mechanism to improve performance and clarity, ensuring it aligns with the intended use cases.
Establish a code review process focused on changes to the `Style` class to catch potential issues before they are merged.
owner_hint: Assign a dedicated team member to oversee changes to the Style class.
